notes: Sentences: select words in a sentence → a small bar appears: ✦ Accent (these words in their own colour inside the caption — set the colour in Style → Karaoke → ✦ Accent words) or 🎨 Style ▾ (the phrase becomes its own caption in the preset you pick; ✕ removes it). Marked words are highlighted in the row; they survive text edits and cuts. Punctuation is now Off / ?! only / All: by default commas and full stops go, ? and ! stay (older presets switch to ?! only; pick Off for the old look). ✓ exact now shows voice / Body / phrase styles like the render.
